values: 耀光帝国最尊贵的明珠，在皇家近卫的保护下，使用魔法海螺的力量治疗朋友们。
The precious princess of the Lightbearer Empire, guarded by the royal guard as she heals her friends with her magic conch.
卫兵列队！随本公主出击！
Guards, form ranks! Follow me into battle!
先深吸一口气 ，然后……对！就是这样。
Take a deep breath... Just like that!
Hmph. That's nothing to a princess like me.
本公主驾到，还不快快行礼？
Your princess has arrived. Why aren't you bowing yet?
阁下，日安……好啦，这可是本公主的最高礼节！
Good day... There, that's the highest courtesy I offer.
小可爱……我来摸摸……啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！哼！
Little cutie... let me pet you... Ahhh! Hmph!
Listen! You can hear the tide coming in.
哇！这是你准备的惊喜嘛！
Is this the surprise you prepared for me?
沐浴帝国荣光而生，亦为帝国未来而战。
Fight for the Empire that once cradled you in its glory.
小心，不要掉进兔子洞哦！
Watch your step! Don't fall into the rabbit hole!
本公主勉强承认，这里还算舒服！
I suppose I can admit it. This place is quite comfortable!
这里的氛围可比王宫轻松多了！
The atmosphere here is far more relaxed than the palace!
有没有草莓蛋糕和红茶呀？
Do you have strawberry cake and black tea?
佩吉出行时总有帝国卫兵寸步不离地护卫，但佩吉总是想方设法甩开他们。
Peggy always has imperial guards escorting her whenever she goes out. She is also very good at making those guards suddenly lose track of her.
佩吉最喜欢的坐骑是猎场中一匹毛色银白的小马，她特意吩咐照看马匹的卫兵要喂给这匹小马最好的草料。
Peggy's favorite mount is a silver-white pony from the royal hunting grounds. She personally instructed the stable guards to feed it only the finest fodder.
佩吉的枕头下压着她的秘密日记本和冒险小说，至于上课要用到的纹章学和古代史典籍，只有在女官大扫除的时候，才能从某个落满灰尘的角落里翻出来。
Under Peggy's pillow are her secret diary and a stack of adventure novels. Her heraldry and ancient history books, meanwhile, only ever turn up in some dusty corner during the maids' deep cleaning.
王宫首席裁缝很是苦恼，她为佩吉公主缝制的所有华丽长裙，下摆处总会莫名其妙地出现草屑和泥点，就像公主穿着它们去丛林里打过滚一样。

The palace's chief tailor is troubled by one great mystery: every beautiful gown she makes for Princess Peggy somehow comes back with grass and mud on the hem, as if the princess had been rolling through the woods in it.
据说，佩吉评判一位贵族是否值得交往的标准，是看他敢不敢在国王的宴会上用吃剩的骨头和她玩投掷游戏。迄今为止，只有罗万这么干过，还因此赢得了不少金币。

They say Peggy judges nobles by one simple test: whether they would dare play a throwing game with leftover bones at the king's banquet. So far, only Rowan has passed, and he even won a good amount of gold doing it.
佩吉非常珍爱她的斑斓海螺，每晚都要把它放在枕边陪伴自己入睡。
Peggy treasures her colorful conch so much that she keeps it by her pillow every night when she sleeps.
佩吉常帮背着父亲偷偷训练的格温妮丝打掩护，作为回报，格温妮丝也私下教了佩吉不少骑术技巧。
Peggy often covers for Gwyneth when she sneaks off to train behind her father's back. In return, Gwyneth has secretly taught Peggy plenty of riding tricks.
第一次见面时，佩吉曾试图与布拉达克一世搞好关系，方式是摸布拉达克一世的头，结果是被布拉达克一世狠狠啄了一口。
When Peggy first met Bradduck, she tried to make friends by patting him on the head. Bradduck responded with a fierce peck.
佩吉曾经口头任命一只白猫为御前首席捕鼠官，一只贵宾犬为御前首席治安官，一只天鹅为御前首席礼仪官，并试图以公主的名义主持任命会议。会议最终因官员们彼此斗殴而被迫终止。

Peggy once verbally appointed a white cat Chief Royal Mousecatcher, a poodle Chief Royal Magistrate, and a swan Chief Royal Etiquette Officer. Her official "appointment" ceremony ended early when the new officers started fighting.
虽然经常和罗万斗嘴，但在罗万生病的那次，佩吉破天荒地安静读了一下午书给罗万解闷——虽然读到一半她自己先睡着了。
Peggy bickers with Rowan all the time, but when he fell ill, she did the impossible: sat still and read to him all afternoon. She fell asleep halfway through, but still. Miracles happened that day.
以前我只听迪尔格雷说过，这里到处都散发着“魔法气息”。
Cyran used to say this place was soaked in "magical atmosphere," but I thought he was just being dramatic.
殿下，请小心，这些食物来源不明，万一有问题……
Your Highness, please be careful. We don't even know where some of these desserts came from...
佩吉，你这次又是怎么从王宫里溜出来的？
Peggy, how did you manage to sneak out of the palace this time?
听着，皮帕，如果等会有守备军找了过来，你就说你没看见我！
Listen up, Pippa! If the palace guards come looking for me, just say you didn't see me!
本公主勉强承认，这里还算舒服！
I suppose I can admit it. This place is quite comfortable!
有没有草莓蛋糕和红茶呀？
Do you have strawberry cake and black tea?
